svg.title: The costs come now, for certain, and the vision someday, maybe: your line says which costs it can't buy.
svg.desc: On the left, four costs in a list, solid because they come now and for certain: a lost weekend, a rushed launch, a hidden result, a user who gets hurt. On the right, one large circle with a dotted outline, the vision, which may come someday. An arrow marked "for the mission" runs from the first two costs to the vision. A heavy line cuts the list in two, under the second cost, and it is highlighted: your line, drawn before anyone asks. Below it sit the hidden result and the user who gets hurt, and no arrow runs from them.
